name: Snatch
description:
About This Game

Snatch takes the timeless idea of Pong and dials it up to eleven. This is not just bouncing a ball back and forth—it’s about speed, strategy, and unleashing a wild arsenal of powers against cunning AI rivals. Every match is a duel of reflexes, tactics, and chaos.


Key Features

  • Pong, evolved – Classic mechanics meet modern chaos, with explosive abilities and dynamic arenas.

  • Single-player challenges – Battle tough AI opponents in 1v1 duels or survive against 4 enemies at once.

  • Ability overload – Dash, deflect, warp, blast—mix and match abilities to outsmart and overwhelm the opposition.

  • Fast, addictive matches – Designed for quick play sessions where “just one more round” always turns into ten.

  • Colorful, energetic style – Bright visuals and flashy effects make every match a spectacle.
short_desc: Snatch is a wild twist on classic Pong—faster, flashier, and loaded with abilities. Deflect, dash, and unleash chaotic powers in fast paced matches. Battle relentless enemies in 1v1 duels or survive 1v3 chaos—dash, deflect, and dominate in fast-paced, single-player arcade mayhem.
